ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white to 15% low-intensity black pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field spanning the central and medial regions of both lobes; low-intensity black border (5-20 pixel width) along the trailing edge and lobe tips; distinct low-intensity circular blobs (3-5 count) located on the upper-right distal quadrant; vertical low-intensity linear feature originating at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 12% of the lobe's height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration with approximately 18-22 detectable peaks across the combined trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitude ranges from 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a concave curve from the notch toward the distal tips; distal tips exhibit a sharp convex, 'hooked' upward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of small, roughly circular low-intensity pixel groups on the right lobe, primarily concentrated in the upper-medial region and along the distal trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct vertical low-intensity linear mark at the median notch base; several faint, nearly-parallel horizontal gray linear disruptions on the right lobe medial surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical dark scar/streak originating from the center of the median notch and extending toward the peduncle connection.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, asymmetric black pigmentation density at the far-right distal tip compared to the left tip.
